description: Read a text file in your workspace. Shows at most 2000 lines or 50KB, whichever comes first; when cut, the last line tells which offset to continue from. Read big files in parts with offset and max_lines. Errors: PathBad, FileMissing, FileBad (not a text file).

path.description: the file, relative to your workspace

offset.description: first line to read (the first line is 1)
